node.title: Re: How to sub class-es
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I agree with [Fletch] that you'd have to show us an [id://1177642|SSCCE] for us to comment on what might be going wrong in your case. Subclassing generally works fine in Perl if you use the appropriate patterns and idioms. Note that [mod://Exporter] has nothing to do with OO and should normally not be used in OO classes, and [doc://parent] should be used instead of [doc://base] unless you know for certain why you need the latter.
